sources: World Gold Council, 'How much gold has been mined?' (gold.org, checked 25.11.2026): total above-ground stocks about 224,200 tonnes at end-Q3 2026, valued at about US$30.0 trillion; figures rounded to the nearest 100 tonnes.

Volume: 224,200 t / 19.32 t per m3 (density of gold) = about 11,600 m3 -> cube edge about 22.6 m (WGC states about 22.6 m for all gold ever mined). Seven storeys at about 3.2 m = 22.4 m. Tennis court (doubles) 23.77 m x 10.97 m; two side by side about 23.8 m x 21.9 m.
